prompts.bee:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square raster image: a charming honeybee hovering in front of a completely opaque, vivid, flat solid green (#00FF00) PAINTED WALL. The green wall is an essential visible part of the image, fills every background pixel edge to edge, and MUST remain visibly bright green in the delivered image. Do not remove the green wall or replace it with transparency. The entire image must be opaque.
Subject: one complete honeybee, strict side profile facing RIGHT, centered with generous margins around its entire silhouette, two raised ivory wings fully visible, fuzzy honey-gold abdomen with broad dark brown bands, rounded fuzzy thorax, small expressive dark eyes, clear antennae and tucked legs. No green on the bee. Honeybee silhouette and broad color shapes must stay readable when displayed at 64 by 48 pixels.
Style: cozy semi-realistic 2.5D platform game character, polished warm hand-painted 3D-rendered materials, golden-hour sunset lighting ON THE BEE ONLY. Soft warm highlights, rich brown shadows, tactile short golden fuzz. No realistic outdoor environment.
Composition: bee occupies about 65 percent of square width, all body parts and raised wings completely in frame, floating centered in front of the uniform painted green wall. Wall is flat solid untextured #00FF00 with no gradients or shadows.
Constraints: exactly one bee and visible opaque green wall only. No flowers, no scene, no props, no floor, no text, no border, no watermark, no multiple poses, no trails, no drop shadow, no transparency, no checkerboard. Keep the opaque green background in the PNG.
